Description

SVR Sun Secure Easy Stick SPF50+ is a high-protection sunscreen stick designed for sensitive skin and sun-exposed areas such as the face, lips, nose, ears, hands, scars, and healed tattoos. The transparent gel-stick texture glides smoothly onto the skin, providing broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays while helping defend against visible light and oxidative stress. Description

Anivagene Lighten-Eye Intense Eye Care Cream is a targeted eye treatment designed to reduce the appearance of dark circles, puffiness, and fine lines around the delicate eye area. Formulated with polysaccharides, oligopeptides, oligosaccharides, and nourishing botanical oils such as olive oil, it helps improve skin microcirculation and supports a smoother, more rested appearance. The formula works to brighten the under-eye area while helping to strengthen and firm the skin, reducing signs of fatigue and early aging. Its lightweight texture absorbs easily without irritation, making it suitable for daily use on all skin types, including sensitive skin. With regular use, it helps the eye contour look more refreshed, hydrated, and youthful.

How To Use

Apply a small quantity and pat around the sensitive eye area with your finger, until absorbed. Use every morning and evening. Do not rinse.

Description

This gel attenuates the dark circles around the eyes thanks to its lightening action while reducing puffiness.

Dépiwhite gel counters the effects of the main factors responsible for the formation of dark circles and puffiness around the eyes by activating micro-circulation.

How To Use

Apply Depiwhite eye contour gel morning and evening to the eye contour.
